description.value: BC Liquor Stores (branded BCLIQUOR) in Keremeos is a provincially operated retail outlet selling wine, spirits, beer, coolers, ciders, and non-alcoholic beverages, run by the BC Liquor Distribution Branch. It is one of 198 stores across British Columbia serving over 36 million customers annually. Touring cyclists passing through the Similkameen Valley can stop here for beverages and take advantage of the store's container recycling program.
